summary.content:
Today's selection covers 93 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 62 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: UK government rejects 'kill switch' idea for dangerous AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Passkey-themed phishing attacks lead to Microsoft 365 data theft
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
